title: My Family and Yours
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Hello, Adam. Do you have a big family?
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا آدم. هل لديك عائلة كبيرة؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Hello, Lina. Yes, my family is quite big.
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا يا لينا. نعم، عائلتي كبيرة نوعًا ما.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: How many people are in your family?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: There are six people in my family.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Who are they?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: My mother, my father, two sisters, my brother, and me.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Are your sisters older than you?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: One sister is older, and one is younger.
dialogue.translation_ar: إحدى أختَيّ أكبر مني والأخرى أصغر.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What does your mother do?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: She is a teacher. She works at a school.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: And what about your father?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: He is a bus driver. He likes his job.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you live with your family?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, we live in a small house near the park.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، نعيش في منزل صغير قرب الحديقة.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. I have one brother.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Is your brother older or younger?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل أخوك أكبر أم أصغر منك؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: He is younger. He is only ten years old.
dialogue.translation_ar: هو أصغر مني. عمره عشر سنوات فقط.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Do you spend time together?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes. We play games every Friday.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم. نلعب الألعاب كل يوم جمعة.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Family time is important.

questions.question: How many people are in Adam's family?
